name: Nginx Cloudflare
author: Vava22
description: Independent Pelican Nginx/PHP 8.2–8.5 runtime with Git, Composer, Cron, optional ionCube, Certbot, WordPress and Cloudflare Tunnel. Maintained by looting2; MIT runtime originally by Ym0T, Pelican adaptation by Vava22.

installation.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "[SETUP] Installing installer dependencies"
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git tar
cd "${SERVER_DIR:-/mnt/server}"
mkdir -p logs tmp www
stage="$PWD/.runtime-install"
[[ ! -e "$stage" ]] || { echo "[SETUP] Remove stale .runtime-install after checking its contents."; exit 1; }
mkdir "$stage"
trap 'rm -rf -- "$stage"' EXIT
repository="https://github.com/looting2/pelican-nginx-egg"
revision="$(git ls-remote "$repository.git" HEAD | cut -f1)"
[[ "$revision" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || { echo "[SETUP] Cannot resolve runtime revision."; exit 1; }
curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
    "https://codeload.github.com/looting2/pelican-nginx-egg/tar.gz/$revision" -o "$stage/runtime.tar.gz"
mkdir "$stage/source"
tar -xzf "$stage/runtime.tar.gz" -C "$stage/source" --strip-components=1 --wildcards \
    '*/nginx/*' '*/php/*' '*/modules/*' '*/start-modules.sh' '*/safe-start.sh' '*/scripts/*.sh' '*/LICENSE'
bash "$stage/source/scripts/install-runtime.sh" "$stage/source" "$PWD" "$revision"

# Never remove an existing site during reinstall.
if [[ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS:-}" ]]; then
    if [[ -n "$(ls -A www)" ]]; then
        echo "[Git] Existing www preserved; use GIT_STATUS for subsequent pulls."
    else
        export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
        if [[ -n "${USERNAME:-}" && -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
            # Credentials stay in the environment, not remote URLs or console output.
            export GIT_ASKPASS="$stage/askpass"
            printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/bash' 'case "$1" in *Username*) printf "%s\n" "$USERNAME";; *) printf "%s\n" "$ACCESS_TOKEN";; esac' > "$GIT_ASKPASS"
            chmod 700 "$GIT_ASKPASS"
        fi
        branch=()
        [[ -z "${GIT_BRANCH:-}" ]] || branch=(--branch "$GIT_BRANCH" --single-branch)
        if ! git clone "${branch[@]}" -- "$GIT_ADDRESS" www > "$stage/git.log" 2>&1; then
            echo "[Git] Clone failed; check repository URL, branch and credentials." >&2
            exit 1
        fi
    fi
elif [[ "${WORDPRESS:-0}" =~ ^(true|1)$ && -z "$(ls -A www)" ]]; then
    curl --fail --silent --show-error --location https://wordpress.org/latest.tar.gz -o "$stage/wordpress.tar.gz"
    tar -xzf "$stage/wordpress.tar.gz" -C www --strip-components=1
elif [[ -z "$(ls -A www)" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' '<?php echo "Pelican Nginx is ready."; ?>' > www/index.php
fi
echo "[DONE] Runtime installed. Start the server with bash ./safe-start.sh."

variables.name: Certbot Domain
variables.description: Primary domain name for SSL certificate (e.g., example.com or subdomain.example.com)

variables.name: Certbot Email
variables.description: Email address for Let's Encrypt certificate notifications and recovery

variables.name: Certbot Force Renewal
variables.description:
Force certificate renewal even if currently valid (useful for testing)

0 = Only renew when needed (default)
1 = Always force renewal

variables.name: Certbot Staging Mode
variables.description:
Use Let's Encrypt staging server for testing (does not count against rate limits)

0 = Production (default)
1 = Staging/Testing

variables.name: Certbot Webroot Path
variables.description: Document root path for webroot validation mode (only used when Mode = webroot)

variables.name: Cloudflared Tunnel Token
variables.description: The authentication token used to connect to the Cloudflare Tunnel service (typically starts with "ey...").

variables.name: Composer Packages
variables.description: Space-separated list of Composer packages to install

variables.name: Cron Config File
variables.description: Path to crontab configuration file

variables.name: Enable Auto-Update
variables.description: Check this fork’s latest published GitHub release at startup (1/true = enabled). No releases or network failure leaves the runtime unchanged.

variables.name: Enable Certbot SSL
variables.description:
Enable automatic SSL certificate management with Let's Encrypt Certbot

0 = false (default)
1 = true

variables.name: Enable Cloudflare Tunnel
variables.description: Set to true to start the Cloudflared tunnel on container startup, or false to skip it.

variables.name: Enable Composer Module
variables.description: Enable or disable Composer package installation

variables.name: Enable Cron Module
variables.description: Enable cron job scheduling for automated tasks like Laravel scheduler

variables.name: Enable Git Module
variables.description: Set to true to enable the Git update module, or false to disable it.

variables.name: Enable LogCleaner Module
variables.description: Set to true to run the log cleanup module on container startup, or false to disable it.

variables.name: Force Auto-Update
variables.description: Apply this fork’s released runtime scripts automatically (1/true). Default 0 checks only. Back up first: scripts/modules are replaced; nginx/php config, site, logs and tmp are preserved. Image upgrades are manual.

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description:
Password to use with git.

It's best practice to use a Personal Access Token.
https://github.com/settings/tokens
https://gitlab.com/-/profile/personal_access_tokens

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Optional branch cloned for a new empty site. Runtime updates fast-forward this branch; do not use to switch an existing checkout.

variables.name: Git Repo Address
variables.description: Website Git repository URL to clone into an empty www directory. Example: https://github.com/your-account/your-website.git

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description: Username to auth with git.

variables.name: PHP Version
variables.description: Required PHP version (8.2, 8.3, 8.4 or 8.5). Must match the selected image.

variables.name: Wordpress
variables.description:
Enable or disable Wordpress 

0 = false (default) 
1 = true
